selection_rule.shards: Within workers 0..99 rank frozen split shards using tag '<split>:shard', value relative shard. Select train=2, dev=5, local_test=5 per worker.
selection_rule.rows: Within each selected shard rank rows 0..111 using tag '<split>:row', value '<shard>:<row>'. Before dev row ranking exclude exact frozen dev_smoke_panel members. Select train=100, dev=5, local_test=5 per shard.
selection_rule.train_monitor: Within each worker rank its 200 selected train pairs using tag 'train_monitor', value '<shard>:<row>'; select first 5.
selection_rule.dev_monitor: Within each selected dev shard rank its 5 selected pairs using tag 'dev_monitor', value '<shard>:<row>'; select first 1.
selection_rule.dev_quality: Within each worker rank its 5 dev_monitor pairs using tag 'dev_quality', value '<shard>:<row>'; select first 1.
selection_rule.serialization: Entries ordered by numeric worker then shard path; row indices ascending. Canonical checksum is SHA256 of UTF8 JSON with sorted keys, compact separators and ensure_ascii=False, excluding manifest_sha256.
